# Aipim

> A small, open, Brazilian design system with all the parts in place: foundations, 16 HTML and CSS components, 63 line icons, one Markdown spec per component, documentation and a token generator that enforces accessibility checks. Made to be customized, and to be used by people and by AI agents.

Aipim uses semantic tokens (`--aipim-*` CSS variables) in light and dark, plain HTML and CSS components (`aipim-<component>` classes), and line icons from Hugeicons Free. Colors come only from semantic roles; state is never shown by color alone; every interactive element has a visible focus ring.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/AGENTS.md): the rules for building with Aipim, setup, patterns and how to verify
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/README.md): what Aipim is, how to use the tokens and the components, how to customize

## Foundations

- [color.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/color.md): Color: ramps, semantic roles and the accessibility checks
- [typography.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/typography.md): Typography: Antonio and Karla, ten styles and the rules
- [space-shape-motion.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/space-shape-motion.md): Space, radius, borders, sizes, elevation, z-index, motion and opacity

## Guides

- [workflow.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/workflow.md): Workflow: how stakeholders, designers and engineers work together with Aipim, stage by stage, with checklists
- [voice-and-microcopy.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/voice-and-microcopy.md): Voice and microcopy: how Aipim sounds and how to write buttons, labels, errors, empty states and dialogs
- [verification.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/verification.md): Verification: what has been checked on the web components, how, when, and the known limits
- [documentation-layout.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/documentation-layout.md): Documentation layout: how a component page is built in the Figma file (masthead, nine rows, stages, drawings, tables)

## Components: Actions

- [Button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/button.md): The main action of a screen or block. Class `aipim-button`.
- [Icon button](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/icon-button.md): A button that shows only an icon. Class `aipim-icon-button`.
- [Link](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/link.md): Takes the reader to another page or section. Class `aipim-link`.

## Components: Data entry

- [Text field](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/text-field.md): A single-line field for short typed text, with a visible label above it. Class `aipim-field`.
- [Checkbox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/checkbox.md): Lets a person pick any number of independent options. Class `aipim-checkbox`.
- [Radio](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/radio.md): Lets a person pick one option from a short list. Class `aipim-radio`.
- [Switch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/switch.md): Turns a setting on or off, and the change applies right away. Class `aipim-switch`.

## Components: Feedback

- [Alert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/alert.md): An important message that stays visible on the page. Class `aipim-alert`.
- [Toast](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/toast.md): A quick confirmation that goes away on its own. Class `aipim-toast`.
- [Empty state](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/empty-state.md): What a list, search or area shows when there is nothing to show yet. Class `aipim-empty-state`.

## Components: Navigation

- [Top bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/top-bar.md): The title of a screen, with a back button and up to two actions. Class `aipim-top-bar`.
- [Tab bar](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/tab-bar.md): The main navigation on phones, with three to five destinations. Class `aipim-tab-bar`.
- [Tabs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/tabs.md): Switches between views of the same content. Class `aipim-tabs`.

## Components: Content & overlays

- [Card](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/card.md): Groups related content on one surface. It can be a single link. Class `aipim-card`.
- [Tag](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/tag.md): A short label for a category, a technology or a status. Class `aipim-tag`.
- [Modal](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/docs/en/components/modal.md): A decision or short task that needs attention, on top of the page. Class `aipim-modal`.

## Code and tokens

- [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/tokens/tokens.json): every token in the W3C Design Tokens format (the single source)
- [aipim.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/tokens/build/css/aipim.css): the tokens as CSS custom properties, light and dark
- [aipim-components.css](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/components/web/aipim-components.css): every component in one stylesheet
- [aipim.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/components/web/aipim.js): optional script for tabs keys, dismiss buttons and dialog commands
- [icons.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/icons/icons.json): the 63 icons, with their names and categories
- [sprite.svg](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/talis-galhardi/aipim/main/icons/sprite.svg): the icons as an SVG sprite
